title: 实习生拿工资吗  (Do Interns Draw a Salary?)

segments.t: In the Xingtian corridor, data-company boss Ji Xiu praises Chun Yuqiao's secret guest strategy, just before upset intern Bu Xiaogu confronts him for treating staff like chess pieces. Listen to what happens.
你是怎么想到请柳凡的？真佩服你！
你们的备用方案比我的数据还要准。
柳凡一直都是我的第一方案。
我的天哪，你们把我骗得太惨了！
为什么你把员工当棋子？
你让我们的努力白白浪费了！
你们这样也叫努力工作？
你以为你们真的能做这个节目吗？
看了二十年电视，你就能做电视了？
念了几年书，你就觉得自己专业了？
你的老师天天夸你吧？
实习生拿工资吗？去努力工作！
Let's walk through each line. The visiting boss starts by applauding the surprise move.
你是怎么想到请柳凡的？真佩服你！
'How did you think of inviting Liu Fan? I really admire you!' "Xiangdao" means hitting upon an idea, and "peifu" expresses genuine admiration for someone's skill.
你们的备用方案比我的数据还要准。
'Your backup plan was even more accurate than my data.' To say 'even more than', Mandarin frames the comparison as "A bi B hai yao...", ending here on "zhun", 'accurate'.
柳凡一直都是我的第一方案。
'Liu Fan was my first-choice plan all along.' "Yizhi dou shi" stresses that something stayed true from beginning to end without changing.
我的天哪，你们把我骗得太惨了！
'Oh my goodness, you fooled me completely!' "Wo de tian na" exclaims 'my heavens!', while "pian de tai can le" says she got tricked terribly.
为什么你把员工当棋子？
'Why do you treat staff members like chess pieces?' Pairing "ba" with "dang" builds 'treat X as Y': "yuangong", 'employees', treated as "qizi", 'chess pieces'.
你让我们的努力白白浪费了！
'You made all our hard work go to waste for nothing!' Doubling "bai", 'in vain', into "baibai" sharpens the sting before "langfei", 'waste'.
你们这样也叫努力工作？
'You call what you did working hard?' Slipping "ye jiao", 'also counts as calling', into a question challenges whether her effort deserves the name.
你以为你们真的能做这个节目吗？
'Do you think you can really make this show?' Starting with "ni yiwei", 'you suppose', almost always signals that the listener's assumption is mistaken.
看了二十年电视，你就能做电视了？
'After watching television for twenty years, can you suddenly make television?' Notice how the same word "dianshi", 'television', shifts from watching with "kan" to producing with "zuo".
念了几年书，你就觉得自己专业了？
'After studying for a few years, do you think you are a professional?' "Nianshu", literally 'read books', means 'study in school', contrasted with "zhuanye", 'professional'.
你的老师天天夸你吧？
'Your teacher praises you every day, right?' Doubling "tian", 'day', into "tiantian" gives a brisk 'every single day' right before "kua", 'praise'.
实习生拿工资吗？去努力工作！
'Do interns draw a salary? Go work hard!' Mandarin says "na gongzi", literally 'take wages', for getting paid a salary. Now let's listen to the whole corridor confrontation again.
你是怎么想到请柳凡的？真佩服你！
你们的备用方案比我的数据还要准。
柳凡一直都是我的第一方案。
我的天哪，你们把我骗得太惨了！
为什么你把员工当棋子？
你让我们的努力白白浪费了！
你们这样也叫努力工作？
你以为你们真的能做这个节目吗？
看了二十年电视，你就能做电视了？
念了几年书，你就觉得自己专业了？
你的老师天天夸你吧？
实习生拿工资吗？去努力工作！

Yuqiao's harsh lecture stings Xiaogu's pride, even before she learns he actually fought to keep her at Xingtian. You learned "peifu" for 'admire', "ni yiwei" for challenging a wrong assumption, and "na gongzi" for drawing a salary. See you next time!
下次见！
